programme_name: Máster Universitario en Estadística para la Ciencia de Datos
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4316664, Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA), Nivel MECES 3, Máster RD 1393/2007; verificación 06/06/2018, BOE 21/12/2018 y 26/07/2019, renovación de acreditación favorable 17/01/2024
ects: 60 (RUCT breakdown: 39 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 6 TFM; programme page also states 60 ECTS)
language_of_instruction: Inglés (idioma de impartición stated on the Spanish programme page www.uc3m.es/master/estadistica-ciencia-datos)
tuition_total_eur: EUR 7,200 for the 60-ECTS programme (120 EUR/ECTS x 60 = 7,200), plus 450 EUR reserva de plaza which is deducted from the first tuition payment; small admin fees extra (apertura de expediente 27.54, secretaría 6.11, seguro escolar 1.12)
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 rates — page states 'Precios vigentes para el curso 25/26, pendientes de aprobación por la Comunidad de Madrid para el curso 26/27'; 2026-27 and 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED
non_eu_surcharge: yes — explicit two-tier price on the programme page: 80 EUR/ECTS for Spanish/EU students vs 120 EUR/ECTS for non-EU students (a 50% surcharge, +2,400 EUR over the 60-ECTS programme)
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT: 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 for title 4316664). Applicant level: the programme page states no complementos de formación; admission is by academic-committee assessment of background in mathematics, statistics and programming — NOT FOUND as an explicit applicant-level complementos rule.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 (Sept 2027 intake) calendar NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. Published 2026-27 calendar (general masters, three rounds): 1 DICIEMBRE 2025 - 31 ENERO 2026 (resolutions from 27/02/2026); 1 FEBRERO 2026 - 31 MARZO 2026 (resolutions from 30/04/2026); 1 ABRIL 2026 - 31 MAYO 2026 (resolutions from 23/06/2026). Do not shift these forward.
notes: RUCT code confirmed independently two ways: (a) the programme page's own 'Información sobre el carácter oficial del título' link carries codigoEstudio=4316664; (b) the RUCT register row for UC3M. Programme page admission status currently reads 'Plazo de admisión: CERRADO'. The uc3m.es/postgrado/matricula/precios page does NOT carry the per-ECTS table — it redirects the reader to each master's own MATRÍCULA tab, which is where the 80/120 EUR split is published. No separate earlier visa round is advertised for non-EU applicants.

programme_name: Máster Universitario en Métodos Analíticos para Datos Masivos: Big Data
official_status: máster universitario (official) — RUCT 4315583, Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA), Nivel MECES 3, Máster RD 1393/2007; verificación 03/08/2015, BOE 24/12/2015, 22/02/2016, 31/03/2017; renovación de acreditación favorable 12/12/2024
ects: 60 (RUCT breakdown: 48 obligatorios + 6 optativos + 6 TFM; programme page also states 60 ECTS). An OPTIONAL 12-ECTS 'complemento MBA' can be added on top at extra cost.
language_of_instruction: Inglés (idioma de impartición on the Spanish programme page www.uc3m.es/master/big-data; English-language version titled 'Master in Big Data Analytics')
tuition_total_eur: EUR 7,200 for the 60-ECTS programme (120 EUR/ECTS x 60 = 7,200), plus 450 EUR reserva de plaza deducted from the first payment. Optional MBA complement adds 12 x 330 EUR/ECTS = 3,960 EUR for non-EU students if taken.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 rates (UC3M publishes 'precios vigentes para el curso 25/26, pendientes de aprobación por la Comunidad de Madrid'); 2026-27 and 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED
non_eu_surcharge: yes — explicit: 80 EUR/ECTS Spanish/EU vs 120 EUR/ECTS non-EU; the optional MBA complement is likewise 225 EUR/ECTS EU vs 330 EUR/ECTS non-EU
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (the 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row is absent for title 4315583 — this is not the same as 0). Applicant level: no compulsory complementos stated; the page requires demonstrated background in Mathematics (algebra, calculus), Statistics (probability, inference) and basic programming, and applicants from other fields (ADE, Economics, Health Sciences) may be admitted if they evidence that knowledge. The 12-ECTS MBA complement offered is OPTIONAL and is not a bridging requirement.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 (Sept 2027 intake) calendar NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25. Published 2026-27 general-masters calendar: 1 DIC 2025 - 31 ENE 2026; 1 FEB - 31 MAR 2026; 1 ABR - 31 MAY 2026 (resolutions 27/02, 30/04, 23/06/2026). Programme page currently shows 'Plazo de admisión: CERRADO'.
notes: RUCT code confirmed from the programme page's own carácter-oficial link (CodigoEstudio=4315583) and cross-checked against the RUCT register. Reserva de plaza of 450 EUR is payable within 10 calendar days of the admission notification.
